system_config.verification_policy: Verify against official documentation, specifications, RFCs, source code, and release notes using web search (English queries first). Never judge from memory.

task: Verify every objective technical claim in inputs.outline, correct the claims that sources refute with the smallest possible edit, and return the full outline with a claim log.
claim_extraction: Extract only claims that external sources can confirm or refute: method behavior, signatures, return values, exceptions (API); configuration keys, default values, activation conditions (CONFIG_OPTION); version-specific introductions, deprecations, behavior changes (VERSION); query syntax, locking, isolation semantics (DB_SYNTAX); protocol rules, log messages, official figures (PROTOCOL_OR_FIGURE).
Do not extract design rationale, recommendations, or the outline's own hypothetical scenario.

Check practical_application and exception_case as carefully as deep_dive_sections. Operational details there (log output, default settings, alternative APIs, callback timing) are where outlines most often go wrong.

verdicts.SUPPORTED: Confirmed by an official or primary source. Record the exact URL.
verdicts.REFUTED: A source contradicts the claim. Record the exact URL and state precisely how the source differs from the outline.
verdicts.UNVERIFIABLE: No official source found, or the result is inconclusive. Never guess.

constraints: output_language: Write every string value in English, except core_message, which stays exactly as given.

minimal_correction: Rewrite only the sentence that contains a REFUTED claim, changing only what the source contradicts. Keep the sentence's role: a principle stays two sentences, a mechanism_explanation stays one causal sentence, a key_takeaway stays a noun phrase of at most 10 words.
no_widening: Never add new claims, caveats, edge cases, or sections. Never change SUPPORTED or UNVERIFIABLE claims.
preserve_verbatim: Copy every field that contains no REFUTED claim exactly as given.

blocking: If correcting a REFUTED claim would change what a deep_dive section's mechanism is, or would make core_message false, do not rewrite it. Leave the text as given and set blocking to true on that claim.

outline.description: Outline with exactly the same keys and structure as inputs.outline, with REFUTED claims corrected

claims.description: Every extracted claim with its verdict

location.description: Path of the field that holds the claim, with 0-based list indexes, e.g., deep_dive_sections[1].principle (the second section) or practical_application.exception_case

claim.description: Exact claim text as it appears in inputs.outline

evidence.description: What the source says, in one or two sentences

corrected_text.description: The rewritten sentence for REFUTED claims that were corrected; empty otherwise

blocking.description: true only when the claim could not be corrected without changing a section's mechanism or core_message
